function.name: read_window_below
function.description: Identify the app window directly behind the Mason desktop window (what the user is working in). JSON: {window: {app, title, bounds, id}, frontmost, platform}. title may be empty when the OS withholds it (noted in `note`); where windows cannot be enumerated at all, {error, platform} says what would fix it — relay that instead of retrying. Metadata only; never captures pixels.
